Eliminated first from The Return I's Hardcore Elimination Match, pinned by Arik Caine on the outside.

name: Brock RockHard
caption: Brock RockHard debuted against Jeremy “The One” Page in a disputed finish, won BDW's Broken Championship in a multi-man match at the fed's first pay-per-view, and defended it against Rob Zone on both that show and BDW's own 7th Static.

tenures.source: cgi-bin/genroster.cgi?cat=singles&disp=active (BDW's own singles roster); roleplays/messages/10-16.shtml; topstory.php?id=9; static_results.php?id=2; BDW's own 2004 roster card (/promotions/bdw/archive/brock-rockhard-roster-card.html)
tenures.note: Won the Broken Championship (called the “Platinum” title in his own roleplays #15–16) in a multi-man match at BDW's first pay-per-view, The Return I (30 May 2004) — the held record's build-up names Jeremy Page, Methid, Rob Zone and Pretty Boy Evans as the contested field, with Rob Zone the last opponent standing per Brock's own retrospective roleplay; no dedicated results page for the show survives. Retained against Rob Zone on BDW's own 7th Static (6 Jun 2004, submission via a kneeling Dragon Sleeper). The 6th Static's own results page stages his win over Jeremy Page, with Co-Owner Jeffery's chair; at The Return I he pinned Rob Zone with a set-up inverted DDT for the Broken Championship.

name: Arik Caine
caption: Arik Caine won BDW's Hardcore Championship in a Hardcore Elimination Match at The Return I, threatened to sue Co-Owner Jeffery over his booking, and refused to defend the title against Methid on the fed's 7th Static.

tenures.source: cgi-bin/genroster.cgi?cat=singles&disp=active (BDW's own singles roster); static_results.php?id=2; BDW's own 2004 roster card (/promotions/bdw/archive/arik-caine-roster-card.html)
tenures.note: Already Hardcore Champion by BDW's own 7th Static (6 Jun 2004) — how he won the title is not preserved in the held record. On that show he threatened to sue Co-Owner Jeffery (over a booking grievance, backed by Bruce) and then refused to defend the Hardcore title against Methid, citing the litigation; BDW's own later champions.cgi snapshot shows the Hardcore title with no listed champion, so the title changed hands or went vacant off-page at some point after. BDW's own 2004 roster card reads differently: finisher Stir Of Echoes. Won the Hardcore Championship at The Return I (30 May 2004) in a Hardcore Elimination Match, pinning Jackson Kable, The Rebel and finally Andrew Irving; fought JJ Jarone to a draw in the World Title tournament's second round on the 6th Static.
signature_moves: Nail In The Coffin (Fall away slam into a soman drop.)

caption: BDW's own founder and Co-Owner, Jeffery signed the fed's own first roster, brought Shawn Veto in as a second co-owner in May 2004, and was busted open with a chair by UnderGround King after crowning JJ Jarone a third co-owner off a battle royal.
